propositions: acli_graph.py hand-rolls the same cursor-pagination loop three times with no runaway-token guard, allowing a server that repeats the same nextPageToken to spin the loop forever (cabc bug class).
The three maps wrap pagination loops in fail-open exception handlers that degrade to partial results, masking runaway-token failures as silent partial data.
A shared cursor iterator with RunawayPaginationError must escape the fail-open handlers to signal data-integrity violations, while ordinary transport exceptions continue to degrade gracefully.
All three cursor-pagination loops in acli_graph.py must be consolidated into a single shared _iter_cursor_pages iterator with consecutive duplicate token detection.
Offset-protocol pagers (fetcher._iter_pages, jira_datacenter/transport.py::_paged_search) remain unchanged; only cursor-protocol consolidation is in scope.
